title: Payments — Refund Endpoint Implementation
description:
Implement POST /payments/refund API endpoint. Supports full and partial refunds via Stripe Refunds API.

Acceptance criteria:
- Accepts payment_intent_id, amount (optional — if omitted, full refund)
- Validates amount does not exceed original charge
- Handles partial refund edge case (multiple partial refunds summing to original amount)
- Writes refund event to payment_audit_log (NEX-219)
- Returns refund_id, status, refunded_amount

Partial refund edge case discovered and fixed during implementation (standup_02). Full test suite included in PR #53.
